descriptions.job-0bdkqjc:
ABOUT HUT 8

Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next-generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place.

About the Role

This role provides the essential drafting, diligence, and legal oversight required for the execution of the company's energy and related infrastructure strategy. You will be responsible for the negotiation of power-related agreements for the Company's growing energy infrastructure platform, spanning grid-supplied power, on-site and behind-the-meter generation, and the acquisition of power-related assets. This role requires a sophisticated understanding of how energy regulatory frameworks and utility timelines dictate project viability.

You will be responsible for structuring power supply arrangements and managing the legal risks associated with generation, interconnection, and transmission capacity, including drafting and negotiating energy service agreements, power purchase agreements, retail service agreements, fuel supply arrangements, and interconnection and other utility infrastructure agreements. You will be responsible for conducting due diligence related to power availability in connection with potential acquisitions of powered land and related infrastructure assets. Success in this role depends on your ability to align energy obligations with construction schedules, financing covenants, and customer commitments.

About You

  • Energy Subject Matter Expert: You possess deep knowledge of the North American power grid, including interconnection, transmission and distribution approval processes, and complex tariff structures. You have deep familiarity procuring power in both regulated utility markets and competitive retail energy markets, with working fluency in one or more major markets (e.g., ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP).
  • Technical Negotiator: You have a proven track record of lead-negotiating multi-party infrastructure deals.
  • Strategic Risk Manager: You can identify and mitigate regulatory and operational dependencies—such as curtailment risks and upgrade obligations—before they impact project delivery.
  • Integrated Advisor: You excel at serving as an energy subject-matter expert for cross-functional teams in Strategic Transactions, Finance, and Development, and can translate complex regulatory and commercial issues into clear guidance for business decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive negotiations for interconnection agreements, shared facilities and other co-tenancy agreements, transmission service agreements, distribution arrangements, and other utility infrastructure agreements.
  • Negotiate and structure power supply agreements, energy service agreements, retail energy supply agreements, and ancillary service arrangements.
  • Support the development and procurement of on-site and behind-the-meter generation, including negotiation of fuel supply and gas transportation agreements, equipment supply and EPC arrangements for generation assets, and offtake structures for emerging technologies.
  • Represent the Company's interests in utility large-load tariff proceedings, special contract negotiations, and related regulatory dockets impacting power procurement and cost allocation.
  • Provide legal analysis of utility tariffs and rate structures, and manage regulatory compliance matters associated with owned or contracted generation assets, including FERC, NERC, and state public utility commission requirements.
  • Negotiate energy trading and hedging documentation, including ISDA, NAESB, and EEI master agreements and related credit support arrangements, in coordination with finance and risk teams.
  • Support participation in demand response, curtailment, and ancillary services programs, including structuring arrangements that monetize load flexibility.
  • Support the negotiation of power-related provisions in customer agreements, including power pass-through mechanics, ramp schedules, and power-related service levels, in coordination with leasing and commercial counsel.
  • Advise on renewable energy procurement, including renewable energy certificates (RECs), green tariffs, and structures supporting customer sustainability commitments.
  • Stay current on key policies impacting generation procurement, interconnection, transmission and distribution, and power procurement regulations.
  • Own the power-related portions of project financing deliverables, including diligence requirements and lender covenants.
  • Prepare and negotiate letters of intent, asset purchase agreements, and membership interest purchase agreements related to the acquisition of power-related assets.
  • Manage legal risks and disputes related to operating assets.
  • Direct energy-specific outside law firms with a focus on budget control and internalizing institutional knowledge.
  • Invest in training, mentoring, and scaling of legal and paralegal support resources as the energy platform grows.

Qualifications

  • Active license to practice law in at least one U.S. state and a member in good standing of one U.S. bar.
  • Expertise negotiating power purchase agreements, interconnection agreements, retail supply agreements, and utility infrastructure arrangements.
  • Familiarity with FERC and state public utility commission regulatory frameworks; experience with NERC reliability standards and energy trading documentation (ISDA/NAESB/EEI) is highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting project finance transactions, including lender diligence and covenant negotiation.
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, and communication (written and verbal) skills.
  • Strategic thinker with a practical, business-oriented approach to legal issues.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

About the Work Environment

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WHAT MAKES HUT 8 A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

Hut 8 offers a benefits and wellness program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as paid time off. We are proud to invest in building the best team in the industry. At all levels of the organization, we are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, radical transparency, and relentless growth mentality.

At Hut 8, you will have the opportunity to:

▶ Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting

▶ Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government

▶ Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team

▶ Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Growth BI Project Manager to join our CEO Office. This is a high-impact, end-to-end role that sits at the intersection of data intelligence and execution — covering OKX's key regulated markets globally. You will own the full loop: identifying growth problems through data, diagnosing root causes, shaping recommendations, and driving outcomes through cross-functional execution.
Beyond technical and operational skills, what will set you apart is who you are. We are looking for someone with an exceptional ability to learn fast and operate in unfamiliar territory without losing direction. Someone who does not wait to be told what matters — you find it yourself. Someone who genuinely cares about the work and brings energy to problems that others find too messy or too ambiguous to touch.

What You'll Be Doing

Growth Analytics & Insight
  • Monitor core growth metrics across regulated markets, proactively identifying anomalies, trends, and emerging opportunities.
  • Conduct structured root-cause analysis on growth performance — moving beyond data description to diagnosis: why did this happen, and what should we do about it.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for senior leadership and local market growth teams.
  • Build and maintain analytical frameworks and dashboards that give leadership a clear, real-time view of market health and growth efficiency.
Program Management & Execution
  • Own the end-to-end execution of key growth initiatives: from scoping and planning through to delivery and outcome tracking.
  • Drive cross-functional coordination across growth, product, engineering, and operations teams — ensuring alignment, accountability, and on-time delivery.
  • Define measurable success criteria for each initiative and close the loop on results.
AI-Augmented Ways of Working
  • Actively apply AI tools and automation to accelerate analysis, reporting cycles, and operational workflows.
  • Champion AI-native practices within the team and demonstrate productivity gains through concrete examples.

What We Look For In You

  • At least 4 years of experience in growth analytics, business intelligence, strategy, or program management — ideally from a top internet company, fintech, Web3 firm, or management consulting background.
  • Exceptional learning agility — able to rapidly absorb new domains, connect the dots across unfamiliar data, and develop informed views in areas where you had no prior expertise.
  • Strong logical and quantitative thinking — you break complex problems into structured components and form conclusions grounded in evidence, not assumption.
  • Extreme self-motivation and ownership — you take full accountability for your workstreams, set your own direction, and are not satisfied until you see measurable outcomes. A genuine drive and passion for the work — you thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, and find clarity and momentum where others find friction.
  • Excellent communication skills; able to adapt between technical and non-technical audiences, and comfortable presenting to senior leadership.
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin Chinese is preferred to work with stakeholders in Mandarin-speaking markets.
 

Nice to Haves

  • Prior experience in the Web3 or crypto industry, or as a user of crypto products — genuine familiarity with the space is a meaningful advantage.
  • Hands-on experience building AI agent systems or complex workflows, beyond general tool usage.
  • Experience working within international or multinational organizations, with cross-regional stakeholder exposure.
  • Solid track record in growth analytics or channel analysis — comfortable working with acquisition, retention, and channel performance data, and experience translating analytical work into growth decisions.
 

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is seeking a Senior Partnerships Manager to develop and own a portfolio of Square's strategic partners in Australia. This role reports to the Partnerships Lead, APAC.

The role will involve designing, negotiating, and scaling partnerships for Australia as the primary focus, but with a view to install best practices globally where opportunities present themselves. This is primarily a Business Development role, though deep expertise in partner management is required.

Partners within the Australian portfolio include referral networks, distributors, service providers, technology platforms, and strategic ecosystems where there's mutual benefit to sellers through lead generation, co-sell, co-marketing, and product enablement. You'll use your deep payments knowledge and creativity to land win-win deals across all partner types.

This is a senior individual contributor role at the intersection of business development, growth, product, and go-to-market strategy. You will set the vision for your assigned partner portfolio. You will then work globally and cross-functionally, using your payments and relationships expertise to turn your vision into business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sourcing & Negotiation: Evaluate and secure high-impact partners and where required, identify and qualify them; lead executive-level negotiations and close deals that advance our capabilities and growth.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Product, Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Legal to ensure smooth execution and maximum impact.
  • Growth Accountability: Deliver measurable results in lead generation, seller acquisition, and pipeline contribution through strategic partnerships.
  • Activation & Scaling: Launch product partnerships with clear GTM plans, co-marketing initiatives, and integrated roadmaps where relevant.
  • Executive Relationship Management: Build and sustain C-level relationships with partners, ensuring long-term value creation.
  • Measurement & Optimization: Define and track KPIs for partnership success, adjusting strategy as needed to drive continuous growth.

You Have

  • 8+ years in the payments space across roles such as business development, strategic partnerships, and/or product partnerships 
  • Proven track record of structuring, launching and scaling high-impact partnerships, and where required, sourcing such partnerships
  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with extensive experience working at the executive level.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect partnership strategy directly to measurable seller acquisition and revenue outcomes.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with global teams and functions, with a proven ability to thrive in this environment by collaborating globally in order to execute locally.
  • SaaS, fintech, or payments background strongly preferred. Whilst eCommerce experience will be valued highly, in-store experience is preferred.

岗位概述

负责高价值客户的开发与维护，深入了解各家产品与解决方案，通过专业够听和定制化的解决方案，推动交易、资产及收入等关键指标的持续增长。该岗位高度 KPI 导向，需要强目标感、快速学习能力，同时能接受高强度出差。

主要工作职责

1- 开发与拓展

  • 通过多渠道（线下拜访、行业会议、社群、转介绍等）挖掘并开发潜在高价值客户（包括但不限于专业交易者、家族办公室等）。
  • 能够快速画像并识别高潜力目标客户，建立并维护客户线索池和跟进节奏。

2- 客户关系管理与业绩达成

  • 建立并维护稳固的客户关系，定期Review，了解用户交易需求、资金规模与产品需求。
  • 对所负责客户的 资产规模、交易量、收益贡献等关键指标（KPI）负责，按月度/季度完成业绩目标。

3- 产品与解决方案咨询

  • 深入理解各家主流交易平台的各产品条线（如：现货、合约、期权、Earn/理财、结构化产品等），能够为客户提供对比分析和专业建议。
  • 收集客户需求与痛点，协同产品、运营等团队，为重点客户提供定制化解决方案。

4- 行业洞察与学习

  • 持续跟进行业动态、竞品策略和新产品形态，快速掌握并消化新知识，形成对客户有价值的观点与建议。
  • 定期输出客户/市场反馈与竞品情报，为内部策略和产品迭代提供一线视角。

任职要求

  • 至少 2 年及以上 web3 行业工作经验，对主流交易所、钱包、托管、DeFi 等产品有实际使用或服务经验。
  • 能够 快速识别与筛选目标客户，具备优秀的沟通谈判技巧与关系维护能力，有高潜力客户的客户关系管对金融市场、衍生品、风险收益等有基本认知，有银行、券商、资管等金融背景者优先。理、客户服务和运营等相关工作经验优先；
  • 明确的 KPI & 结果导向，习惯用数据衡量业绩。
  • 能接受 高强度工作节奏与频繁出差 / 拜访。
  • 自驱力强，抗压能力好，能够在不确定环境中找到路径并推动落地。
  • 能够 中英文双语工作（听说读写）；
  • 本科及以上学历，金融、经济、会计、数学、统计、计算机等相关专业优先。

Role Overview

Responsible for acquiring and managing high-value clients, developing a deep understanding of different products and solutions across platforms, and driving sustainable growth in trading volume, assets and revenue through professional consultation and customized solutions. This is a highly KPI-driven role that requires strong goal orientation, fast learning ability, and the ability to handle frequent business travel.

Key Responsibilities

1- Client Acquisition & Expansion

  • Identify and acquire potential high-value clients (including but not limited to professional traders, family offices, etc.) through multiple channels such as in-person visits, industry events, communities and referrals.
  • Quickly profile and identify high-potential target clients, maintain a structured lead pipeline and follow-up rhythm.

2- Client Relationship Management & Target Delivery

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients; conduct regular reviews to understand their trading needs, capital scale and product preferences.
  • Take full responsibility for key KPIs of your client portfolio, including asset under management, trading volume and revenue contribution, and achieve monthly/quarterly performance targets.

3- Product & Solutions Advisory

  • Develop an in-depth understanding of major product lines on leading trading platforms (e.g. spot, perpetuals, options, Earn/wealth management, structured products, etc.) and provide professional comparison and recommendations to clients.
  • Gather client needs and pain points, and work with product, operations and other internal teams to deliver customized solutions for key clients.

4- Industry Insight & Continuous Learning

  • Continuously track industry trends, competitor strategies and new product types; quickly absorb new knowledge and translate it into valuable insights and suggestions for clients.
  • Regularly share client/market feedback and competitive intelligence to provide frontline input for internal strategy and product iteration.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of work experience in the Web3 industry, with hands-on usage or service experience related to major exchanges, wallets, custody solutions, DeFi products, etc.
  • Able to quickly identify and qualify target clients, with strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills. Experience in managing high-potential client relationships, client service or account operations is preferred. Basic understanding of financial markets, derivatives and risk–return; background in banking, securities or asset management is a strong plus.
  • Clear KPI & result orientation, and comfortable using data to measure and manage performance.
  • Comfortable with a high-intensity work pace and frequent travel / client visits.
  • Strong self-motivation and resilience, able to find paths forward and drive execution in an uncertain environment.
  • Able to work in both Chinese and English (listening, speaking, reading and writing).
  • Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or related fields are preferred.

Founded two decades ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people across North America, Europe and Asia. DV Equities is the group's Asia-Pacific equities and futures market-making business, trading cash equities, ETFs, index futures and related products on exchanges across the region.

As a Quantitative Trader Graduate, you will join our DV Equities desk and participate in the execution and risk management of systematic trading strategies across global equity markets, learning our proprietary methodologies and systems through hands-on experience.   • Participate in the execution and risk management of systematic trading strategies, including trade execution and risk layoffs

  • Enhance existing strategies and identify new opportunities through data-driven research
  • Liaise between the trading desk, internal teams, and OTC relationships
  • Monitor live trading performance and iterate on models based on real-time market feedback

  • Strong proficiency in Python; experience with SQL, statistical modeling, or C++ is highly preferred
  • Strong foundation in math, probability, and statistics
  • Genuine interest in financial markets, algorithmic trading, and market microstructure
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and perform in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
  • Ability to maintain composure and communicate clearly under pressure
  • Exceptional problem-solving ability and multitasking skills

Brave is building the independent search infrastructure for the AI era.

Brave Search API powers leading AI companies, applications, and developer frameworks. We’re looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager who can understand our technology, translate it into clear market value, and help accelerate adoption across the LLM, agent, and RAG ecosystems.

About the Position

We are looking for Quantitative Researchers to help us build models, strategies and systems that price and trade financial instruments. You'll apply your experience in experiment design, dataset generation, time series analysis, feature engineering and model building to financial datasets, while collaborating with colleagues who will challenge and refine your approach.


At Jane Street, our researchers, engineers and traders sit a few feet away from each other and work together to train models, architect systems and run trading strategies. We work with petabytes of data and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Depending on the day, we might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging distributed training performance or studying how our model likes to trade in production.

We don’t believe in “one-size-fits-all” modelling solutions; we are open to and excited about applying all different types of statistical and machine learning techniques, from linear models to deep learning, depending on what best fits a given problem.
